headline: As of 2026-10-02: 928,887 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 28 of 50 states, D+35.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 928,887 early/mail ballots cast so far across 28 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+35.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (313,567), New Jersey (134,390), Florida (97,163).
